subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers explicitly override the live credential gap for this narrow header fix?
rationale: The source-level fix is narrow and well covered, but the repository's external API proof bar normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, and the contributor says they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key.

options.title: Require live smoke before merge
options.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer add redacted endpoint-detection output showing a Coding Plan key selecting the coding endpoint after this patch.

options.title: Accept a maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the credential gap because the issue already has live before-fix evidence and the patch only adds the missing header.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers choose one of the sibling candidate PRs for the same issue.

recommendation.title: Require live smoke before merge
recommendation.body: Have the contributor or a maintainer add redacted endpoint-detection output showing a Coding Plan key selecting the coding endpoint after this patch.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof-sufficiency decision is tied to the plugin-auth boundary and Z.AI endpoint detection behavior that steipete moved into the plugin path.
